reviewer: pass-with-notes (head bf124e64f1297601cba277ce4d1eea3709a0a272)

## A) Verdict

Both round-1 P2 findings are closed. No remaining blocking correctness
findings. N255-001 below is a **P3 C34 follow-up**, not another review gate.

Content reviewed at be735f65e73b96f758e3a09248bf4b4d6662cff9 against
c68ac8f7fb8adb84af2fe0372276cef51686c802. The rebase onto main 2f269126
is confirmed by `git range-diff c68ac8f7~1..be735f65 2f269126..bf124e64`:
commit 1 changes only the difficulty-ledger context to retain main's
D-F212-1; commit 2 is identical. Every reviewed plan, script, output,
workstream, retro and velocity file is byte-identical across the rebase.

## B) Summary

The achievable estimate now preserves the residuals actually observed
under toolSearch=false, while the all-flips-removed estimate is explicitly
an optimistic bound. Historical rate fitting, calibration and TTL figures
stop at END. Process restarts clear the mechanistic cache. The evidence
supports completing this measurement step, not a universal claim that the
proxy saves money or a decision to retain it.

## C) Checklist

- Read-only review of the exact detached content; no product edits or builds.
- Both analysis scripts independently rerun, with outputs confined to reviewer scratch.
- Nine isolated pricing, residual, expiry, restart, hindsight and mutation-control groups pass.
- Four canonical documents validate with zero errors/warnings; all four generated faces have no drift.
- AC5's dated observations independently reconstructed; s07 and Delivers agree.
- Final rebased-head range-diff: passed. All five exact-head checks pass;
  `just pr-freeze 255` returned FINAL with agreeing remote/GitHub heads,
  main base, CLEAN merge state and a clean detached review tree.

## D) Findings

| ID | Severity | Disposition | Finding and concrete fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| F255-001 | P2 | Closed | Historical figures are bounded to END; adding a future observation leaves every historical table unchanged. Removing the guard is detected by history_is_closed. |
| F255-002 | P2 | Closed | The achievable estimate keeps token-only, reload-adjacent and first-resume residuals. Both actual canary reload records retain their billed cost; only the labelled optimistic bound removes them. |
| N255-001 | P3 | C34 follow-up | `plan.dd.json:102` and PR prose describe 1.09% as 5 flips out of 470. `assets/sim232.py:387-401` correctly divides by the 457 same-process comparisons; 470 includes restart comparisons. Display the actual same-process denominator and align the prose, including the analogous before-window description. No cost estimate or decision changes. |

Paths above are under `docs/plans/232-proxy-tool-flips/`.

## E) Detailed evidence

Every historical table, calibration line, partial counterfactual,
sensitivity and TTL result reproduces byte-for-byte, excluding the run
timestamp and live window. The token-class identity also holds separately
for every one of the 43,138 historical records, rather than only in aggregate.

Achievable savings against plain reproduce as **+8.5% / -11.2%**;
the optimistic bound is **+26.3% / +7.3%**; the reload sensitivity is
**+13.1% / -6.3%**. The after-#243 achievable result is explicitly a loss.

The dated live population independently reproduces:

| Population | n | Billed AIU | As plain AIU | Saving |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| New processes, excluding first requests | 457 | 3,539.2 | 4,010.7 | +11.8% |
| New processes, including 17 first requests | 474 | 5,716.4 | 5,328.9 | -7.3% |
| Old processes | 209 | 2,540.7 | 3,521.9 | +27.9% |

The new-process observations span 3,602.897 seconds from the earliest
process start. The comparable main-agent population has one count flip
and four token-only flips, as documented. AC5 is supported.

The never-upgrade control passes: a 1h marker refreshes a 5m segment only
for 5m, and the later miss pays the 1h write. Hindsight correctly sums
each session's cheaper fixed TTL. Restart and residual controls clear the
cache. The policy ranking still favours 1h for all among the tested
buildable policies. The hindsight bound is only for a constant TTL per
session, not all conceivable adaptive policies.

## F) Acceptance coverage

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC1 | Canary retained; fleet count/reload residuals explicitly qualify it. |
| AC2 | Prefix growth is charged as reads on hits and writes on misses. |
| AC3 | Historical closure mutation, per-record calibration, achievable/bound separation. |
| AC4 | Never-upgrade, restart/residual clearing, constant-TTL hindsight controls and reproduced policy table. |
| AC5 | Independently reconstructed dated populations and 3,602.897-second post-start span. |
| AC6 | s07 complete; req-01/req-07 and Delivers match; existing shipped requirement states unchanged; schemas/rendering clean. |

Thin cells, the single-hour observation window, residual flips and the
mechanistic model's +5.3% calibration error remain explicit limitations.
Security and performance verdicts remain separately owned.

## G) Validation

Read-only reruns of `assets/sim232.py` and `assets/flip_window.py`: passed.
Reviewer scratch controls and independent receipt audit: passed.
`ddocs validate` and `ddocs build --check` on the plan, backpressure,
phase tasks and workstream: all eight calls passed.
Local product builds, dependency operations and the local composite
build/test gate were not run under the packet's no-build/read-only
contract; exact-head CI is the product-build proof.
CI run 44459696651 passes check (22), check (24), rust-lint and rust-test;
delivers run 44459696625 passes. `gh pr checks 255 --watch --interval 30`
exited 0. `just pr-freeze 255` exited 0 and returned FINAL at
bf124e64f1297601cba277ce4d1eea3709a0a272.

No runtime loop, poll, timer, hook, sweep, status line or launch is added
or changed. The scripts are manually invoked analysis, not a per-seat
steady-state activity.

## H) Handover

No blocking changes owed. Carry N255-001 as the named P3 C34 follow-up.
Completing s07 closes the requested investigation; whether to keep the
proxy remains the prime/operator's separate decision.

Harness contribution: the review produced an executable historical-input
closure guard, independently mutation-checked, rather than a reminder to
freeze inputs manually. The remaining small improvement is to emit the
actual rate denominator beside the rate.
